newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel buys some Apple assets.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel buys some Apple assets.

text.p: NatSteel Electronics, a unit of NatSteel Ltd, will acquire all of the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing assets in Singapore of a unit of U.S.-based Apple Computer Inc, Apple said on Thursday.
Natsteel Electronics will supply main logic boards for Apple Computer's regional demand fulfillment operations centre in Singapore, Apple said in a statement.
The increase in NatSteel Electronics' manufacturing capacity would create about 400 new jobs, it said.
The contract, the value of which was not disclosed, was effective from July 14.
The agreement was a step forward in Apple's strategy of focusing operational efforts closer to customers, Apple senior vice president of worldwide operations Jim McCluney was quoted as saying.
